positive.$description: Positive status foreground — green.500 (#22C55E), 8.84:1 on background.primary (neutral.950 #030712), WCAG 2.2 AA. Re-verified. Pair with icon/label.

negative.$description: Negative status foreground — red.500 (#EF4444), 5.35:1 on background.primary (neutral.950 #030712), WCAG 2.2 AA. Re-verified. Pair with icon/label.

warning.$description: Warning status foreground — amber.500 (#F59E0B), 9.37:1 on background.primary (neutral.950 #030712), WCAG 2.2 AA. Re-verified. Pair with icon/label.

info.$description: Info status foreground — blue.400 (#60A5FA), 7.92:1 on background.primary (neutral.950 #030712), WCAG 2.2 AA. Re-verified. Pair with icon/label.

pending.$description: Pending/in-progress — teal.400, ~10:1 on dark base. Distinct from info/warning; pair with icon + label.

neutral.$description: Neutral/uncategorized — neutral.400, ~8:1 on dark base. Pair with label.

positiveSubtle.$description: Dark positive tint panel. Pair with text.primary (≥12:1, AA text) or status.positive (≥3:1, graphical).

negativeSubtle.$description: Dark negative tint panel. Pair with text.primary or status.negative (≥3:1).

warningSubtle.$description: Dark warning tint panel. Pair with text.primary or status.warning (≥3:1).

infoSubtle.$description: Dark info tint panel. Pair with text.primary or status.info (≥3:1).

pendingSubtle.$description: Dark pending pill panel. Pair with text.primary or status.pending (≥3:1).

neutralSubtle.$description: Dark neutral tint panel. Pair with text.primary (≥12:1, AA text).
